_comment: What a TTL module is for (ttl.application) and the roles its pins can take (ttl.pins.<gpio>.role). One source for the module (validation), the controller (rig check, session record, post-processing) and the frontend (the card). plans/ttl-applications-ephys-sync.md

mixed.label: General TTL
mixed.description: Every pin mode and setting, no guidance. Use this when the module does several unrelated jobs.

ephys_sync.label: Ephys sync
ephys_sync.description: Sends a sync pulse train to an ephys acquisition system (Open Ephys) so its data can be aligned with every camera and microphone.

neurologger_sync.label: Neurologger sync
neurologger_sync.description: Sends a sync pulse train to a wireless neurologger so its data can be aligned with every camera and microphone.

stimulus_control.label: Stimulus control
stimulus_control.description: Drives stimuli (lights, shocks, tones via other hardware) from pulse trains or the session protocol.

sync.label: Sync line
sync.description: A pseudorandom pulse train the acquisition system records alongside its own data. Alignment matches these pulses on both sides.

stimulus.label: Stimulus
stimulus.description: A pulse train or the session protocol driving a stimulus.

marker_in.label: Event marker (input)
marker_in.description: Logs each edge on an input line, e.g. a lever press or another system's trigger.
